summary: Hypersolid is global technology & brand experience | Faster than consultancies, smarter than agencies | For the bold and brave, founded in 2024. Type: listed company. About 182 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Hypersolid is a young Alkmaar-based tech and brand-experience group formed in 2024 from four agencies, building AI-driven digital platforms.

culture.text: Founded in 2024 by combining Triple, code d'azur, Wonderland and Connect2Crowd; LinkedIn lists 182 employees.
Hubs in Austin, Amsterdam, Alkmaar and Hilversum; it calls itself a team of makers, founded by coders, without layers of account managers.
Staff often come from Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, Inholland, UvA and Mediacollege Amsterdam, in communication, design and IT.
Its 2 open jobs here are entry-level finance roles in Amsterdam and Alkmaar, with coaching from senior controllers.

open.text: Hypersolid is not an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current postings need no Dutch but average 118 LinkedIn applicants each.

growth.text: The group was formed in 2024 through the merger of four agencies.

worth_knowing.text: It says its human team is increasingly supported by AI agents it built itself.
